Report Description/// CRITICAL INCIDENT COMMUNICATIONS (CIC) REPORT - INITIAL - WATERWAY CLOSURE - CHARLESTON, SC /// LOCATION: COOPER RIVER, CHARLESTON, SC TIME INCIDENT OCCURRED: 1706 ET / 2106 Z TIME OF INITIAL REPORT TO NCC: 1927 ET / 2327 Z NAME OF REPORTING UNIT: USCG SECTOR CHARLESTON AMPLIFYING INFORMATION: - ON JULY 10, USCG SECTOR CHARLESTON INITIATED A CRITICAL INCIDENT COMMUNICATION (CIC) CONFERENCE CALL FOR A LARGE CRANE THAT FELL OFF THE PIER INTO THE COOPER RIVER NEAR COOPER RIVER BUOY 52 DUE TO STORM WINDS. - NO INJURIES TO PERSONNEL OR PERSONS IN THE WATER WERE REPORTED. - USCG SECTOR CHARLESTON ISSUED A SAFETY MARINE INFORMATION BROADCAST (SMIB) AND LAUNCHED USCG STATION CHARLESTON. - USCG STATION CHARLESTON SET UP A 300-YARD SAFETY ZONE AROUND THE AREA OF THE FALLEN CRANE. - A BOOM WAS PLACED AROUND THE AREA, AND SHEENING WAS OBSERVED IN AND OUTSIDE OF THE BOOM. - MAX POTENTIAL POLLUTION FROM THE CRANE IS 500 GALLONS OF DIESEL. - DUE TO THE UNCONFIRMED LOCATION OF THE CRANE IN THE CHANNEL, VESSEL TRAFFIC SERVICE SECURED VESSEL TRAFFIC FOR THE RIVER OUT OF PRECAUTION. - THERE ARE TWO PENDING SHIP DEPARTURES. - ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS WILL CONDUCT AN ASSESSMENT AT 0700 ET ON 11 JULY OF THE EXACT LOCATION OF THE CRANE AND TO CONFIRM IF THE CRANE IS IMPEDING THE CHANNEL. - USCG SECTOR CHARLESTON EXPECTS HIGH MEDIA INTEREST. - NCC WILL CONDUCT A FOLLOW-ON CIC CONFERENCE CALL AT 0800 ET / 1200 Z ON 11 JULY.

ALTHOUGH UNCONFIRMED, THE LEAK WAS POSSIBLY DUE TO DAMAGE TO THE FUEL SUPPLY LINE.
